lead.headline: Corporate Consortium Challenges Stablecoin Duopoly
lead.tldr: A massive shift toward corporate-led stablecoins and RWA tokenization is marginalizing legacy crypto-native players in favor of regulated, institutional frameworks.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the past month and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Stripe, Visa and over 140 other businesses to launch stablecoin to rival Tether and Circle
top_signals.summary: A massive consortium of over 140 businesses, including Stripe, Visa, BlackRock, and Google, is launching a new stablecoin. This initiative aims to create a direct competitor to the current market leaders, Tether and Circle.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The entry of Stripe, Visa, and BlackRock into stablecoin issuance signals a transition from crypto-native liquidity to corporate-controlled payment rails.

top_signals.title: Binance to stop providing services to EU clients after failing to obtain licence
top_signals.summary: Binance is ceasing services for clients in the European Union after failing to secure the necessary licensing under the MiCA framework. The exchange is now instructing users on how to withdraw their funds as the new regulations take effect.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Binance's EU exit demonstrates that MiCA compliance is a non-negotiable barrier to entry for the European market.

top_signals.title: Capital B Gains Authority to Raise Up to $120B for Bitcoin
top_signals.summary: Capital B shareholders have authorized the company to raise up to $120 billion through equity and credit instruments. This massive financing capacity is specifically intended to fund the company's strategic acquisition of Bitcoin.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Capital B's $120B authorization suggests a new scale of corporate treasury Bitcoin adoption beyond the MicroStrategy model.

top_signals.title: Digital Asset Raises $355M in a16z-Led Round at $2B Valuation
top_signals.summary: Digital Asset has raised $355 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, bringing its valuation to $2 billion. The capital will support the expansion of the Canton Network as banks continue to pilot tokenization initiatives.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The $2B valuation for Digital Asset confirms that institutional appetite for tokenization is shifting from pilot phases to scalable infrastructure.

top_signals.title: AI identifies critical bug in Zcash that could have enabled unlimited counterfeit minting
top_signals.summary: An AI-assisted audit identified a critical vulnerability in Zcash's Orchard protocol that could have allowed unlimited counterfeit minting of ZEC. The discovery led to emergency forks and a significant price crash of 38-50%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The Zcash vulnerability highlights the systemic risk of protocol complexity and the growing role of AI in identifying critical security flaws.

top_signals.title: Tether Expands AI push with Lead Role in NEURA Robotics Raise
top_signals.summary: Tether is leading a massive funding round of up to $1.4 billion for NEURA Robotics. The initiative aims to integrate AI technology and cryptocurrency wallets into autonomous robotic systems.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Tether's investment in NEURA Robotics indicates a strategic pivot toward funding the physical AI layer to diversify away from pure financial reserves.

top_signals.title: Bessent backs summer push for Clarity Act, says bitcoin reserve moving at 'deliberate speed'
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent confirmed that the US Treasury is working at a 'deliberate speed' to establish a strategic bitcoin reserve. He also expressed support for a push toward the Clarity Act this summer to provide further regulatory framework.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The US Treasury's 'deliberate speed' toward a Bitcoin reserve provides a long-term fundamental floor for the asset's valuation.

top_signals.title: Inside Trump’s $1.4 billion crypto empire: altcoins, Bitcoin—and a stake in Michael Saylor’s Strategy
top_signals.summary: An analysis of Donald Trump's crypto portfolio, valued at approximately $1.4 billion, highlighting his holdings in Bitcoin and altcoins. The wealth is primarily driven by his family's venture, World Liberty Financial, and strategic ties to Michael Saylor's investment approach.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The scale of political figures' crypto holdings creates a direct feedback loop between personal wealth and regulatory trajectory.

deals.summary: Digital Asset has raised $355 million in a funding round led by a16z crypto, bringing its valuation to $2 billion. The capital will support the expansion of the Canton Network as banks continue to pilot tokenization initiatives.
Tether is leading a massive funding round of up to $1.4 billion for NEURA Robotics. The initiative aims to integrate AI technology and cryptocurrency wallets into autonomous robotic systems.
Framework Ventures has reportedly raised $400 million for a new fund. This fund is specifically designed to expand the firm's investment scope beyond the crypto ecosystem.

Japanese financial giant SBI is acquiring Bitbank in a $289 million deal to establish Japan's largest cryptocurrency exchange. The move is part of SBI's broader strategy to expand its ecosystem across stablecoins, tokenization, and blockchain infrastructure.

Morpho has raised $175 million in a funding round aimed at expanding onchain credit markets. The investment highlights growing investor interest in infrastructure supporting stablecoins and tokenized assets.
Figure is acquiring Kiavi for $717 million to expand its real-world asset (RWA) tokenization network. The move aims to migrate Kiavi's assets on-chain to reduce operational costs and enhance margins.

Morpho, a DeFi startup aiming to bring decentralized finance to mainstream institutional investors, has raised $175 million. The funding round was led by prominent venture firms including a16z crypto, Paradigm, and Ribbit Capital.

Venice AI, founded by Erik Voorhees, has secured $65 million in Series A funding. The company has reached a $1 billion valuation as investors bet on the demand for privacy-centric artificial intelligence.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood Chain goes live on mainnet alongside 24/7 tokenized stocks, Lighter perps and planned crypto agentic trading
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood has launched its own Layer 2 blockchain on mainnet utilizing Arbitrum's technology stack. The network debuts with 24/7 tokenized stocks, Lighter perpetuals, and a partnership with Uniswap, while planning for agentic crypto trading.

on_the_radar.title: Europe's MiCA crypto regime is fully in force: Here's who wins and loses
on_the_radar.summary: The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation has fully entered its final transition phase as of July 1. The regime establishes a comprehensive legal framework for crypto-assets, impacting how companies and users operate within the EU market.

on_the_radar.title: Former Goliath CEO Pleads Guilty to Crypto Fraud, Money Laundering
on_the_radar.summary: Former Goliath Ventures CEO Christopher Delgado has pleaded guilty to fraud and money laundering. The scheme involved taking in at least $400 million and resulting in investor losses of at least $250 million.

on_the_radar.title: Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulations42m, Taiwan’s legislature passes crypto, stablecoin regulationsTaiwan’s legislative branch has passed the nation’s first crypto and stablecoin rules, which aim to integrate the country with the global crypto market.
on_the_radar.summary: Taiwan's legislature has passed its first set of regulations governing cryptocurrencies and stablecoins. The move is designed to integrate Taiwan more effectively with the global digital asset market.

on_the_radar.title: Nasdaq brings proprietary market data onchain through Pyth8m
on_the_radar.summary: Nasdaq has integrated its proprietary market data onto the blockchain via Pyth Network's Pyth8m service. This move bridges traditional financial market data with Web3 infrastructure, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of on-chain price feeds.

on_the_radar.title: UK sets capital, market abuse rules in landmark crypto framework
on_the_radar.summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has finalized a landmark regulatory framework for crypto assets, focusing on capital requirements, stablecoins, and market abuse. These rules are set for implementation by October 2027, providing a clear legal roadmap for the industry in the UK.

on_the_radar.title: Strategy may sell up to $1.25 billion in Bitcoin to calm investor jitters
on_the_radar.summary: Strategy is considering the sale of up to $1.25 billion in Bitcoin to address investor concerns. This move signals a strategic shift away from aggressive accumulation amid deteriorating market conditions.

on_the_radar.title: Tokenization firm Securitize eyes early July NYSE debut with $400 million SPAC deal
on_the_radar.summary: Tokenization firm Securitize is preparing for a New York Stock Exchange debut in early July via a SPAC merger. The deal is expected to provide the company with approximately $400 million in capital.

on_the_radar.title: Binance faces EU service limits next week as MiCA rules take effectBinance will limit EU onboarding and services from July 1 under MiCA rules after failing to gain authorization from a member state, while withdrawals remain available for users.
on_the_radar.summary: Binance will restrict onboarding and certain services for EU users starting July 1 due to the implementation of MiCA regulations. The exchange failed to secure authorization from an EU member state, although existing users can still withdraw funds.

on_the_radar.title: Intercontinental Exchange, OKX expand access to tokenized equities via joint venture co-chaired by former Gov. Cuomo
on_the_radar.summary: Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) and OKX have formed a joint venture to provide users with access to tokenized equities and ICE futures. The venture is co-chaired by former Governor Andrew Cuomo and aims to bridge traditional financial markets with digital asset infrastructure.

on_the_radar.title: Bank of England dilutes stablecoin rules with plan for £40bn issuer limit
on_the_radar.summary: The Bank of England has proposed a shift in its stablecoin regulatory approach, moving away from strict individual holding limits in favor of a £40bn aggregate issuer limit. This change aims to provide more flexibility for companies and individuals to hold digital assets while maintaining systemic stability.

on_the_radar.title: Ethereum Layer 2 Taiko halts block production following exploit; urges users to withdraw funds
on_the_radar.summary: Ethereum Layer 2 network Taiko has halted block production after suffering an exploit. Users are being urged to withdraw their funds as security firm Blockaid investigates a potential flaw in the bridge's source-signal proof validation.

on_the_radar.title: G7 Flags North Korean Cybercrime After $2B Stolen in 2025
on_the_radar.summary: G7 leaders have issued a warning regarding North Korean cybercrime following the theft of at least $2 billion in digital assets in 2025. The alert highlights the increasing scale and sophistication of DPRK-linked hacking operations targeting the crypto ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: Coinbase launching tokenized US stocks, backed 1:1, with holders able to receive dividends
on_the_radar.summary: Coinbase is launching tokenized US stocks that are backed 1:1 by the underlying assets. This initiative allows holders to receive dividends, positioning Coinbase against rivals like Robinhood and Kraken in the RWA space.

on_the_radar.title: Ethena Labs to allocate $250 million to Securitize's Tokenized AAA CLO Fund as it deploys on Solana
on_the_radar.summary: Ethena Labs is allocating $250 million to Securitize's Tokenized AAA CLO Fund. This move coincides with the fund's deployment on the Solana blockchain to provide on-chain access to institutional-grade structured credit.

on_the_radar.title: Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: Report2h, Japan crypto bill advances with ETF, tax reform path: ReportJapan’s Lower House reportedly passed a bill that would bring crypto under the country’s financial instruments framework, potentially opening the door to ETFs and lower tax treatment.
on_the_radar.summary: Japan's Lower House has passed a bill to integrate cryptocurrency into the national financial instruments framework. This legislative move is expected to pave the way for the approval of crypto ETFs and more favorable tax treatments for investors.

on_the_radar.title: Wallets linked to Humanity Protocol drained for over $32 million, token plunges 89%: onchain analyst
on_the_radar.summary: Wallets associated with Humanity Protocol were drained of over $32 million, leading to a massive 89% crash in the project's token price. On-chain analysis reveals that a significant portion of the stolen funds has already been swapped for Ethereum.

on_the_radar.title: BlackRock’s new tokenized fund puts Ethereum’s institutional thesis to the test
on_the_radar.summary: BlackRock has launched a new tokenized fund, utilizing the Ethereum blockchain to facilitate institutional asset management. This move serves as a critical test for the institutional thesis regarding Ethereum's utility as a settlement layer for real-world assets.

linkedin_post:
What I keep coming back to this month is the aggressive consolidation of the stablecoin market. The news of a consortium including Stripe, Visa, and BlackRock launching a rival to Tether and Circle isn't just another product launch; it is a coordinated move to capture the settlement layer of the internet. 

When you pair this with Figure's $717 million acquisition of Kiavi to migrate assets on-chain, a clear pattern emerges. The 'crypto' part of the equation is becoming secondary to the 'efficiency' part. We are seeing a migration where the underlying ledger is treated as a commodity, while the value is captured by those who control the onboarding and the assets. 

I'd watch how this affects the liquidity of crypto-native stables. If the biggest payment rails in the world move to their own issued assets, the utility of Tether and Circle may be restricted to speculative trading rather than global commerce. This raises a real question: can crypto-native issuers survive when the incumbents decide to build their own rails?
